data.why: Arka Fincap announced a major funding round led by The Rise Fund just five days ago. For a fast-growing NBFC CFO, rapid capital deployment directly expands loan disbursements and collection volume that must be reconciled.
data.angle: Surging disbursements and daily loan collections across partner channels make the accounting close heavy and reconciliation-intensive.

not_chosen.reason: Headcount growth of +70% is strong evidence of scale, but the fresh equity round from The Rise Fund five days ago is far more timely and immediate.
Ridhi stepped into the CFO role over 600 days ago, making executive transition far too old to serve as a timely outreach trigger.
Prior tenure at Bandhan AMC reflects past career history rather than an active operational catalyst at Arka Fincap.
Assurance experience at PwC dates back to 2011 and is completely irrelevant for cold outreach today.
Generic market news roundup listing multiple unrelated public conglomerates, with no operational relevance to Arka Fincap.

data.subject: the rise fund
data.body:
Hi Ridhi,

Saw Arka Fincap took on fresh funding led by The Rise Fund. Deploying more capital usually means a steep climb in loan disbursements and collections to reconcile for the close. Who handles all those reconciliations across your banking partners today?

Block cut 75% of the manual steps in its close with Zamp.

Worth a look before year-end?

[Your name]
